meta.title: Community Center Events Calendar
meta.description: A community center's events calendar built with the free Beacon Events plugin: classes that repeat every Tuesday and Thursday, a monthly first-Wednesday meeting, an every-other-Friday open mic, an online talk and a ticketed concert, shown as a month calendar with filters and a week timetable.
meta.author: inmanjeffrey89-cell
